Class SimulatedAnnealingSimulation<S extends AnnealingSolution<S>>

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.sim.simanneal.SimulatedAnnealingSimulation<S>
Type Parameters:
S - concrete solution type for the annealing problem
All Implemented Interfaces:
Simulation
public final class SimulatedAnnealingSimulation<S extends AnnealingSolution<S>> extends Object implements Simulation
A Simulation implementation that performs Simulated Annealing (SA) to minimize an energy (cost) function over a problem-defined solution space.

This class is part of the MDI simulation framework integration:

  • The algorithm itself is UI-agnostic and runs under SimulationEngine.
  • SimulationContext is intentionally minimal (cancellation + timing + step count).
  • Optional UI feedback is posted through an injected AnnealingFeedback channel.

Core algorithm

Each iteration proposes a random move from the current solution (via AnnealingProblem.randomMove(Random, AnnealingSolution)), applies it, evaluates the resulting energy, and accepts or rejects the move using the Metropolis criterion: 

  accept if ΔE ≤ 0
  otherwise accept with probability exp(-ΔE / T)

The temperature T decreases over time according to a schedule; this implementation delegates cooling to the configured AnnealingSchedule. An initial temperature T0 is estimated by a TemperatureHeuristic.

Threading / UI

The simulation engine invokes init(SimulationContext) once and then calls step(SimulationContext) repeatedly until it returns false. Any UI-related updates (messages, progress, refresh) are posted to the engine, which is responsible for EDT marshalling and listener notification.

Move models

A problem explicitly returns either a ReversibleAnnealingMove, which mutates in place and is undone on rejection, or a CandidateAnnealingMove, which leaves the current solution unchanged and returns a separate proposal.

  • Method Details

    • setFeedback

      public void setFeedback(AnnealingFeedback feedback)
      Set the optional output channel used by this simulation.

      The MDI SimulationContext is intentionally minimal and does not provide message, progress, or refresh APIs; the feedback channel supplies them.

      Typical usage from the hosting view: 

      SimulatedAnnealingSimulation<?> sim =
    (SimulatedAnnealingSimulation<?>) getSimulationEngine().getSimulation();
sim.setFeedback(AnnealingFeedback.forEngine(getSimulationEngine()));
      Parameters:
      feedback - output channel, or null to discard output

    • getState

      public SimulatedAnnealingState getState()
      Get a snapshot of the current annealing state.

      The returned value is suitable for display or logging. The temperature reported here is the same absolute temperature used for acceptance decisions: the schedule's relative value multiplied by the estimated T0.

      Returns:
      a state snapshot

    • init

      public void init(SimulationContext ctx)
      Initialize the simulation.

      This method:

      1. Initializes the RNG (seeded or non-deterministic based on config).
      2. Estimates the initial temperature T0 using TemperatureHeuristic.
      3. Generates a starting solution using AnnealingProblem.randomSolution(Random).
      4. Computes initial energy and resets counters.
      5. Posts initialization output through the configured feedback channel.
      Specified by:
      init in interface Simulation
      Parameters:
      ctx - simulation context (cancellation/timing bookkeeping)

    • step

      public boolean step(SimulationContext ctx)
      Perform one annealing iteration.

      The engine repeatedly calls this method until it returns false. This method returns false when:

      • Cancellation is requested via SimulationContext.isCancelRequested()
      • The schedule indicates stopping via AnnealingSchedule.shouldStop(long, SimulatedAnnealingConfig)
      • The temperature falls below SimulatedAnnealingConfig.minTemperature()

      Progress and refresh notifications are throttled according to SimulatedAnnealingConfig.progressEverySteps() and SimulatedAnnealingConfig.refreshEverySteps().

      Specified by:
      step in interface Simulation
      Parameters:
      ctx - simulation context (cancellation/timing bookkeeping)
      Returns:
      true to continue running, false to stop
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the problem returns an unsupported move implementation or a non-finite energy

      public void addAcceptedMoveListener(IAcceptedMoveListener listener)
      Add an AcceptedMoveListener. Duplicate registrations are ignored. This method is safe to call while the simulation and EDT notification drain are active.
      Parameters:
      listener - the AcceptedMoveListener to add.

    • removeAcceptedMoveListener

      public void removeAcceptedMoveListener(IAcceptedMoveListener listener)

      Parameters:
